biggest_catch: No annual fee ($0), so the $150 is pure upside on the fee side — the real constraints are the 90-day clock and the strict net-purchases rule: cash equivalents, balance transfers, fees, gambling, and returns do not count. Only planned spending counts toward the $500 — never buy extra to fill the gap. Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, and the card's 17.49%–30.49% variable APR erases the bonus fast if you carry a balance — pay in full every month.
catches: Only pursue spending you already planned to do — never buy extra things just to hit a bonus threshold; overspending to chase a bonus wipes out the bonus math and is how people lose money on it.
Existing and previous State Farm Premier Cash Rewards accounts do not qualify — this is a new-accounts-only, one-time bonus.
Only eligible net purchases count (purchases minus credits and returns); advances, balance transfers, fees, and gambling transactions are excluded.
The offer cannot be combined with any other bonus offer.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, which can temporarily dip your credit score by a few points.
Carrying a balance at ~20%+ APR (this card: 17.49%–30.49% variable) will erase the entire $150 bonus fast — pay the full statement balance every month.

Apply online and get approved; save your approval confirmation.
Spend $500 in eligible net purchases — your already-planned spending — within 90 days of account opening.
Pay the full statement balance every month so interest never eats the bonus.
